## What is the problem

The gap or frustration this would address. If it relates to an item in
`docs/ROADMAP.md`, link it.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems better.

## Scope

- Area: <!-- frontend / backend / documentation -->
- Release: <!-- current iteration, or A2 -->
- Dependencies: <!-- e.g. "Depends on #12" or "Blocks #15", or "none" -->

## How we would know it works

How a reviewer could verify this once it is built. The project has no automated
tests yet, so pull requests are verified by hand.

## Anything else

Mockups, links, or other context.
